prompt: What microplastic concentrations have been found in Taal Lake?
response: Based on the sources provided in the EvalVault, there is no information regarding microplastic concentrations in Taal Lake. The available literature focuses on fishery resources (Mutia et al., 2018; Muyot et al., 2021), water quality parameters such as dissolved oxygen and nutrients (Querijero & Mercurio, 2016; Hilario & Perez, 2013), phytoplankton and zooplankton communities (Mercurio et al., 2016; Papa & Pagulayan, 2007), local ecological knowledge regarding fish kills (Macandog et al., 2014), and heavy metal contamination (Banta & Salibay, 2023).
